text:
Which statement explains why members of the same homologous series have similar chemical
properties?
A
There are covalent bonds in all the molecules.
B
There are only carbon and hydrogen atoms in all the molecules.
C
There is the same number of carbon atoms in all the molecules.
D
There is the same functional group in all the molecules.

options.label: A
options.text: There are covalent bonds in all the molecules.

options.label: B
options.text: There are only carbon and hydrogen atoms in all the molecules.

options.label: C
options.text: There is the same number of carbon atoms in all the molecules.

options.label: D
options.text: There is the same functional group in all the molecules.
